vetSays.line: 📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek.)
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.

🛡️ the person in their 20s, the line cook, Landon, Oscar and the woman in her 50s met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. the person in their 20s, the line cook, Landon, Oscar, the woman in her 50s are hurt.
🛡️ Karl, Landon, Oscar and Killa met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Landon, Oscar, Killa are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Karl, Landon, Oscar and Killa met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Karl, Oscar, Killa are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amina just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Landon, Jorge, Devon and Amina met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Landon, Jorge, Devon, Amina are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
